meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上此技能后，你的NanoClaw可以通过Resend集成邮件通道，实现异步邮件对话。系统会自动复制适配器、注册通道、安装依赖并构建验证，完成后用户即可通过邮件与机器人通信。
howto.when: 当你需要将NanoClaw连接到Resend邮件服务时，此技能会自动复制适配器、注册通道、安装依赖并完成构建验证，然后引导你设置凭据和连接你的邮箱地址。

say.text: 运行add-resend技能，为NanoClaw添加邮件通道。
say.note: 自动执行复制、注册、安装等步骤。

say.text: 请通过Resend集成邮件，让我能用邮件回复你。
say.note: 需要后续设置凭据和个人邮箱。

say.text: 帮我配置Resend邮件，使我可以通过邮件与机器人交流。
say.note: 技能会引导你完成凭据设置。

howto.what_en: After applying this skill, your NanoClaw can integrate with Resend for async email conversations. It copies the adapter, registers the channel, installs dependencies, builds, and validates. Then you set up credentials and connect your email.
howto.when_en: When you need to connect NanoClaw to Resend email service, this skill automates copying adapter, registering channel, installing deps, building, and testing, then guides you through credential setup and wiring your email address.

say_en.text: Run add-resend skill to add email channel to NanoClaw.
Integrate email via Resend so I can reply to you by email.
say_en.note: Needs credential and address setup later.

say_en.text: Configure Resend email so I can talk to the bot via email.
